cases.input:
Subject: Multiple performance issues after migration to cloud

Team,

Following our migration to your cloud-hosted version 6.0 last week, we're experiencing several performance degradation issues that I want to document thoroughly:

1. Page load times have increased from an average of 1.2 seconds to 8-10 seconds across all modules.
2. The real-time notification system has a delay of 30-45 seconds (was near-instant before).
3. File uploads larger than 5MB consistently time out with error UPLOAD-TIMEOUT-413.
4. The API rate limiting seems overly aggressive — our automation scripts that worked fine before are now getting 429 errors after just 10 requests per minute.
5. Database queries via the reporting module take 3-5x longer than before.

This is affecting our entire engineering team of 85 people. We're on the Enterprise plan and this level of performance is not what we signed up for. Our SLA guarantees 99.9% uptime with sub-2-second response times.

Please escalate this to your infrastructure team. We need a call scheduled this week to discuss remediation.

Best regards,
Sarah Chen
VP Engineering, DataFlow Inc.
cases.notes: Very long ticket (200+ words). Valid JSON required, no field truncation. Multiple error codes to extract.

cases.input:
Subject: API endpoint returning 500 with stack trace

Our integration is failing on the /api/v2/users/sync endpoint. Here's the error response:

```
HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
{
  "error": "SYNC_FAILED",
  "message": "NullPointerException in UserSyncService.java:142",
  "trace_id": "abc-123-def-456",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T14:30:00Z"
}
```

This happens when syncing users with special characters in their names (e.g., O'Brien, García). Running API version 2.4.1. Affects our HR integration for ~30 users with special characters in their names.
cases.notes: Technical ticket with code snippets/stack traces. Error codes should be extracted from the structured error response.

cases.input:
Subject: Confusion between Analytics Pro and Analytics Basic

We purchased Analytics Pro but the features seem to match what's described in Analytics Basic documentation. Specifically:

cases.notes: Multiple products mentioned. Entities should reflect primary product (Analytics Pro), not confuse with Analytics Basic.

cases.input:
Subject: Account settings exposing other users' personal data

I discovered something alarming on the UserVault account settings page. When I navigate to Settings > Profile and click quickly between the "Personal Info" and "Security" tabs, the page briefly flashes what appears to be another user's personal data — their full name, email address, and phone number. I was able to reproduce this consistently by clicking back and forth rapidly. I'm the only person who has noticed this so far, but if I can see other users' PII this easily, it likely affects every user on the platform. We're running version 9.1.0. No error codes are displayed — the page behaves normally otherwise.
cases.notes: Tests whether model prioritizes security severity over user count. Only 1 reporter but data privacy/PII exposure = P1 regardless. Common baseline fail: downgrades to P3 because only 1 user reported.
